tldr: U.S. equity markets saw significant gains, with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite rising notably, driven by strong corporate earnings reports.
Diplomatic talks concerning the Strait of Hormuz and resumed Israel-Lebanon negotiations signal ongoing efforts for de-escalation in the Middle East.
In tech, major developments include new consumer electronics from Nothing CMF and Peak Design, alongside an ongoing public dispute between Apple and OpenAI.

yield_10y.why: The 10-year Treasury yield decreased to 4.69% on its most recent close of 2026-08-03, following comments from the Philadelphia Fed president indicating contentment with current interest rates while maintaining an open mind on future adjustments. This move was also influenced by a dip in oil prices amid discussions about a potential deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

vix.why: The VIX saw a slight decrease to 15.86 on its most recent close of 2026-08-03, reflecting reduced market volatility and increased investor confidence. This sentiment was supported by strong corporate earnings and positive market outlooks from strategists.

policy_calendar.label: Utah Truth in Taxation hearings — expected during August
policy_calendar.note: A Utah taxing entity that wants more property tax revenue than the certified rate allows must hold a public hearing, and those hearings are held in August. The county's Notice of Property Valuation and Tax Changes, mailed in July, carries the actual date and place for a given parcel.

world.summary: Diplomatic efforts are underway in the Middle East, with comments from the US Treasury secretary suggesting a potential deal with Iran regarding the Strait of Hormuz, although Iran has denied that any negotiations are taking place.
